scientific_question: Can a configuration-dependent SU(2)-scalar response gate turn symmetry-labelled square-lattice resonance channels into a seed-robust variational improvement rather than a fixed subspace enlargement?

mechanism.reduced_inputs: six causal local-Schur q,a and two-dimensional position tokens
mechanism.conditioned_operator: trace-centered Frobenius-normalized anticommutator of an A1-projected diagonal gate and a prevalidated response-return operator
mechanism.matched_control: a fixed orthogonal conjugation of every conditioned operator at every parameter point, preserving its spectrum, gate values, parameter count, and operator count

promotion_rule: On square N16 J2/J1=0.5, the conditioned labelled arm must improve fixed-labelled median and worst-seed energy error, improve baseline worst-seed error, win at least four of five paired seeds against the pointwise-isospectral scramble, beat that control in median variance and response-moment error, put every seed below 1e-5 total-energy error, and retain a median minimum channelwise gate standard deviation above 0.02. Triangular N12 remains an exact E2/A2 representation certificate only.
forbidden_actions: change the gate, response channels, controls, seeds, steps, learning rate, or thresholds after seeing results
allow the learned model to access magnetic indices
linearly mix a non-A1 response state into the A1 ground state
inspect individual development seeds before sealing the complete artifact
claim N36, QSL physics, or thermodynamic behavior from this exact-small development
